questions.title: English Club - Part 1

metadata.scenario: What do you usually use the internet for?

questions.stem: Respond to the messages in the group.

questions.prompt: I usually spend 6 hours a day studying English. How do you learn English?
questions.sample_answer:
I often spend two hours a day studying English. I usually use my laptop, computer, and smartphone to practice my listening, reading, writing, and speaking skills. I really like studying English because it helps me relieve stress, improve my knowledge, learn about many things, and make money.

I prefer learning English by watching movies and listening to US-UK songs rather than taking formal courses. This helps me expand my vocabulary, improve my listening skills, and make the process of learning more enjoyable.

questions.prompt: English is a popular language in the world. What are your thoughts on this idea?

questions.prompt: When do you usually use English?
questions.sample_answer:
I often use English when I talk with my friends. I really like studying English because it can help me relieve stress, improve my knowledge, learn about many things, and make money.


I use English whenever I get the chance. I use it to search for information at work, study lessons, or read new books. Sometimes, when I travel abroad, I also use it to communicate with locals. It’s enjoyable because it helps me connect with others and understand their cultures better.
